Luna's talented maid, capable handling of any housework.
Inherited his pretty face from his British mother, thanks to his androgynous looks, he can easily disguise as a girl.
Despite his tough upbringing, he remains a positive and pure attitude towards life.
Hometown: Tokyo, Japan
Asahi's master and a highly talented fashion designer. Despite her cold attitude and sharp-tongued nature, she cares about her friends greatly.
Due to her albinism she can not walk under direct sunlight and was similarly hidden from the public like Yuusei was.
Hometown: Shiga, Japan

Luna's friend and Yuusei's childhood friend. As a child she had a crush on Yuusei but never confessed to him. She is currently trying to become more "girly" so that when she eventually reunites with him she could become his girlfriend.

cast.characterName: ユルシュール＝フルール＝ジャンメール
cast.originalCharacterName: ユルシュール＝フルール＝ジャンメール

segments.text: Hometown: Geneva, Switzerland
Luna's childhood friend but also her self-declared rival. Highly proud of her abilities and noble background, but also very easily deceived by Luna and her own maid Sasha.
Despite what her arrogant nature suggests, she is actually very emotionally fragile and has to work very hard to keep up with Luna as she lacks her natural talent.
Hometown: Kyoto, Japan
Luna's friend and a kind Yamato Nadeshiko who cares greatly for her friends, and especially Asahi whom she is highly fond of.
Due to her lack of interactions with men and her childhood experiences with bullies, she is very afraid of men.
Luna's head maid and Yuusei's senpai, also working as a teacher in Jean-Pierre's new school.
Minato's extremely protective maid. Jealous of anyone who might take Minato away from her.

cast.characterName: サーシャ＝ビュケ＝ジャヌカン
cast.originalCharacterName: サーシャ＝ビュケ＝ジャヌカン

segments.text: Ursule's maid, thinks highly of herself and oftens pranks her master with Luna by introducing her to false conceptions about Japan and the Japanese language.
It is later revealed that Sacha was once one of Jean-Pierre's oldest and capable employees, and that she had feelings for him for accepting her for who she is.
Mizuho's maid, she is dressed up like a man to help Mizuho overcome her fear of men.
Hometown: Tokyo, Japan
Aeon's full sister and Yuusei's half-sister. A hikikomori and an avid gamer.
She has an intense love for Yuusei and is not shy to admit that she is a brocon. She would do anything for him to find true happiness, even if it means sacrificing herself in the process.

Has a habit of referring people with anything other than their true name, such as younger big brother (to Yuusei), Lunachomu (to Luna), model girl (to Bluette), monastery girl (to Meryl), etc. She refers to herself as "imouto" when talking to both of her brothers.
It is revealed later that Resona is actually talented in fashion design. The reason Aeon said otherwise is that so Resona doesn't get on the way of his ambition.
Resona's full brother and Yuusei's half-brother.

It is revealed later in Otome Riron to Sono Shuuhen -Ecole de Paris- that he is not Ookura Shinsei's true son, and that he was conceived in result of his mother's infidelity, making him an illegitimate heir to the Ookura family. His ambition and obsession toward talent was the result of his insecurity from that.
This also means that he and Resona are half-siblings, and he is not related to Yuusei by blood.
